item.title: Cornell Researchers Lower Tantalum Qubit Deposition Temperature to 200°C Using Krypton Gas Sputtering
item.summary: A research team led by Cornell University Assistant Professor Valla Fatemi has developed a low-temperature fabrication process for tantalum-based superconducting qubits, resolving a major manufacturing bottleneck for superconducting quantum processing units (QPUs).
